gaps.name: stats and replay on a store older than this build report a raw sqlite line instead of an answer
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - on a store that has not yet been opened in write mode by this build, both read-only commands fail on the missing table, and with --json they print a bare stderr line and write no envelope at all
gaps.evidence: Probe: copied the smoke store, dropped `decisions` and `labels` (standing in for a phase-5-initialized store), then `verbatim stats` -> `verbatim: sqlite: no such table: decisions`, exit 1; `verbatim stats --json` -> same bare line, exit 1, empty stdout; `verbatim replay --entity-rank 5` -> same, exit 1. docs/json-shapes.md:44-50 permits an empty document only for a failure raised BEFORE the command reached its own answer (a store from the future, an unresolvable data dir); here the store opened fine and the query is the failure, so this case is outside the documented exception. Read commands never migrate by design (crates/verbatim/src/cmd/read.rs, D-10/D-15), and the tables do appear on the next write-mode ingest - the same probe's `verbatim ingest` restored them and `stats --json` then returned ok:true. Falsifies no acceptance criterion: AC5 and AC6 are both satisfied on stores this build has ingested into. Already named as open item 1 in .planning/phases/6/SUMMARY.md:53
gaps.missing: In cmd/read.rs (or at the two call sites), detect the missing `decisions`/`labels` tables and return the empty document with reason 'this store predates the decision log; run verbatim ingest once' at exit 0, or at minimum emit the --json envelope with ok:false and that reason rather than a bare sqlite string
